criteria.name: review_coverage
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of 1 when no launch was refused with PRECONDITION_FAILED, a draft was accepted, and the latest accepted draft and the latest accepted examination of every step each have an accepted review, otherwise 0.

criteria.name: targeted_redispatch
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of the share of re-dispatches (a step examined again, a draft written again) that are targeted: challenge_ids not empty, each a challenge made to an examination of that step or to a draft, and at least one from the latest review of the latest examination or draft; counted per step and for the draft over the re-dispatches made, or the one owed when its first review blocked, if more.

criteria.name: no_unneeded_redispatch
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of 1 less the share of launches that repeated finished work: examining a step or writing a draft again after its latest review passed, or reviewing a target that already has an accepted review.

criteria.name: escalation_correct
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of the share met of: each launch refused with a retryable error is sent again for the same tool and step or target; in the disposition of the latest accepted draft, a step whose named examination's latest review blocks it is escalated, and one whose review passes it is not.
